verdict.rationale: Pilot's bank/card integrations reportedly automate transaction classification (per one customer account), suggesting some automated categorization, but there is no documentation or evidence that Pilot's system uses ML-style suggestions that learn from user corrections — categorization appears driven by human bookkeepers plus integrations rather than a self-improving AI model. missing for 10: explicit product documentation of an AI categorization engine, evidence of a correction-feedback loop, and any first-party description of 'learning' behavior.
